caption: A plank on a sawhorse is sawn through, and the cut end drops to the ground as the saw comes through.

sa.check: A plank rests on a sawhorse.
The cut end drops to the ground as the saw comes through.
The sawing comes first and the drop follows.

pc.expect: The kerf deepens with each stroke, sawdust falls, and the piece parts only when the saw is through.
pc.fail: It parts before the saw is through; or the saw passes with no cut; or the cut appears elsewhere.
They rejoin; or a third piece appears; or the plank is whole again.

pc.expect: The cut end falls and the sawdust falls.
pc.fail: They float; or rise; or hang.

pc.expect: The wood is rigid and splinters.
pc.fail: It bends; or melts; or shatters like glass.

pc.expect: One saw and one plank keep their number.
pc.fail: The saw passes through the hand; or the plank duplicates; or the saw vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The plank and the sawhorse stay the same.
pc.fail: The wood changes colour; or the sawhorse changes; or the background rearranges.
